sources.title: Montana FWP Fishing Access Site Locations — Hannon Memorial
observations: The layer is a point feature class described as fishing access sites managed by Montana FWP; its display field is NAME.
The matching feature has OBJECTID 198, NAME Hannon Memorial, BOAT_FAC Hand Launch, CAMPING Yes, PDFMAP ending in 39754135.pdf, WEB_PAGE https://myfwp.mt.gov/fishMT/fas/39754135, and LMS_ID 39754135.
The feature's geometry in EPSG:4326 is x=-114.14011430662917, y=45.972829569043675, about 4 feet from the coordinate published by the linked FishMT record.
Feature geometry supports identity and site location; the layer does not label the point as a ramp toe.
sources.use: Primary current managing-agency GIS confirmation that the public Hannon facility is an FWP hand-launch site; not proof of a surveyed water-entry coordinate.

sources.title: Montana FWP FishMT — Hannon Memorial FAS
observations: Identifies Hannon Memorial FAS on the Bitterroot River and publishes latitude 45.97282, longitude -114.1401.
Describes a day-use area with a concrete boat launch and identifies boating as an activity.
Provides access directions from Rocky Mountain Road and separates the day-use area from the camping area.
sources.use: Primary confirmation of the exact stored site coordinate, Bitterroot identity, public boating use, and launch availability; it does not describe the point as the surveyed launch toe.

auditEvidence.before: audit-before-public-cache-only.json contains both route occurrences at 45.97282,-114.1401; each was suspicious, about 321.6 feet from the matched Bitterroot flowline and 277.7 feet from mapped water.
auditEvidence.after: Route-specific and full cache-only audits are saved in targeted-after-*.json and audit-after-*.json after adding the route-scoped access anchor.
